summary: Sigma Lithium Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its MD&A and condensed interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with a press release. This routine quarterly report discloses operational and financial updates for the mining company, including a change in presentation currency from CAD to USD. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer periodic report, not a special situation.
